style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: Christmas made extra fun? Yes please. Do it this season and beyond with this Outsunny inflatable Christmas crystal ball, featuring Santa, a reindeer and a Christmas tree inside a snowy world. The polyester shell makes this a tough piece, and with its IP44 rating for mild water resistance, it is suitable for outdoor use in light rain. Inside, five white LED lights make this blow-up decoration glow and sparkle, bringing the night alive. The design includes a festive snow globe scene, and setup is simple: plug into the mains to inflate and turn off to deflate, with a storage bag included. Four ground stakes and two guy ropes are provided to secure it firmly to the ground. Finished in red polyester cloth, this inflatable measures 120W x 120D x 170Hcm, with an overall height of 5.5ft and a 3m cord length. It includes five LEDs with 0.5W power, and a fan powered by DC 12V, 14.4W, 1.2A. Input voltage is AC 220–240V, 50/60Hz, 0.7A, with output voltage DC 12V, 18W, 1.5A. Certified to IP44 standards, Item Label: 844-961V70RD. Please note: the blower must remain plugged in to keep the decoration full, should not be left plugged in for more than eight hours, and is not suitable for heavy rain, snow or wind.
